title: Cal AI Achieves Viral Success Through Influencer Marketing
excerpt: Cal AI generated over $30 million in revenue within two years before being acquired by MyFitness.
body_html:
Cal AI achieved viral success largely due to a network of paid influencers, helping the company generate more than $30 million in revenue over a two-year period.

Following its financial growth, the firm was acquired by MyFitness in March. The financial terms of the acquisition were not publicly disclosed.
